A lacquered herbal case is strapped crosswise while torn prescription slips spiral behind her; distant lanterns and a lightning-lit bell tower build depth. Prioritize an anatomically complete full-body silhouette and an unambiguous launch-flight-landing sequence. Use a 35 mm low three-quarter angle, crisp subject motion with restrained fabric trail, cold rain light against amber windows, photoreal textures, and grounded scale.
